research_questions.RQ1: whether cuRobo nominal clearance predicts independently PhysX-validated perturbation robustness
research_questions.RQ2: whether planning-time safety margin improves robustness and its planning/trajectory cost

perturbation_protocol.right_censoring_rule: if no collision through 60 mm, threshold is null and right_censored_above_60mm is true

outcomes.collision_rate_interpretation: empirical fraction over the fixed 128-direction synthetic set, not real-world collision probability
outcomes.curobo_robustness_role: cross-engine comparison and RQ3 auxiliary analysis

planning_timing_protocol.execution_order_method: precomputed interleaved cyclic rotations with offset (7 * round_index) mod 20

reproducibility_strategy.selection_rule: 12 or 13 lowest SHA-256-ranked directions within every condition; first 16 matrix conditions receive 13, last 4 receive 12
reproducibility_strategy.coverage: all 4 scenes and all 5 inflation levels via every condition
reproducibility_strategy.boundary_refinement_audit_rule: for selected pairs, replay every canonical boundary-refinement magnitude that exists

audit_pairs.selection_rule: lowest pre-result SHA-256 ranks within condition

reproducibility_strategy.failure_policy: stop formal analysis and investigate any real reproducibility discrepancy

parallelization_policy.role: execution acceleration only; not a scientific variable or contribution

forbidden_protocol_changes_after_freeze: select directions using pilot or formal collision outcomes
change the 2-mm coarse grid or 60-mm cap
stop coarse evaluation after first collision
change timing repetitions, warm-up, or schedule based on results
silently modify Formal Baseline Set V1 or Formal Safety-Margin Matrix V1
revision_policy: any required post-freeze change must create an explicit V2 with a documented reason
